<!-- General -->

<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ styles/styles.css }" />
<style>
    .header-wrapper {border-bottom: solid 1px #f1f2f2;}
    .promo-banner { background-color: #00556c !important; max-height: 30px;}
    .preheader { max-width:1175px; margin: auto}
    .site-spacing {max-width:1200px; margin: auto}
    .preheader-height { max-height: 30px}
    .minicart-icon,.profile-menu-icon {float:right}
    .profile-menu-icon {
        .slds-icon {
            fill: rgb(255 255 255) !important;
        }}
    .profile-menu-icon .menu-button:hover {background-color: initial !important}
    .header-content {
        .layout-header-desktop { padding:0; justify-content: space-between;}
        .header-badge-icons { display: none}
    }
    .mega-menu { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700;}
    .mega-menu nav ul li {
        a, button { color: #00556c !important;border-bottom: 3px solid transparent}
        a:hover, button:hover { background: none;color: #fb4f14 !important;border-bottom: 3px solid #fb4f14;}
    }
    .mega-menu ul.slds-grid li:first-child .slide-down li:first-child {display: none;}
  
    .suggestions-combobox-container {max-width: 266px; float: right;}
    .input-container {flex-direction: row-reverse;}
    .input-search-button {padding: 5px 8px; border 1px solid #fb4f14;}
    .column-background-color {background-color: #00556c}
    .column-background-light {background-color: #f7fbfb;}
    .q-listing-filter .slds-combobox__input {background: transparent; border: 0;margin-top: 5px;}
    
    .q-minicart-wrapper .lwc-nqurjj9ig5-host {z-index: 9;}
    .q-minicart-wrapper .panel-content {padding: 1rem !important;}
    .q-minicart-wrapper  h2.slds-panel__header-title  {font-size: 30px}
    .q-minicart-wrapper a.description-name-label {color: #00556c !important}
    .q-minicart-wrapper .slds-button.dxp-button-small {padding: 5px; font-size: 1rem}
    .q-minicart-wrapper .slds-panel__body li.large-layout {padding: 1rem 0 !important;}

    .header-search-button{
     .input-search-button {border-left: 1px solid #aaa !important; border-right: unset !important; height: 37.6px !important;}
     .lwc-5j9kqrar72e.input-wrapper {border-left: unset; height: 37.6px; width: 218px;}
     .slds-icon{width: 30px;}
     }
    .why-quest, .quest-headings {
     .dxp-text-heading-xlarge {font-size: 39px; font-weight: bold; font-stretch: normal; font-style: normal; line-height: 1.36; letter-spacing: -0.39px; color: #00556c;} 
     }
    .tiles-second-text {
     .dxp-text-heading-medium{font-size: 60px; font-weight: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-style: normal; letter-spacing: -0.6px;}
     }
    .hp-tiles {height: 284px; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 25px 50px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 16%); background-color: #f7fbfb; padding: 34px 22px 30px;}
    .Footer-sub-categories {
     .dxp-text-body{font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; font-stretch: normal; font-style: normal; line-height: 1.36;}
     }
    .product-tile-wrapper {
     .slds-icon-text-default:active {--slds-c-icon-color-foreground: #fe4f14 !important;}
     }
     @media (max-width: 48em) {  
     footer.lwc-6eunnnt8cg {padding-left: 10px !important; padding-right: 10px !important;}
     }
     @media (max-width: 48em) { 
     .footer-expandable-section{
      .title.lwc-4r1413ceuog, .content.lwc-4r1413ceuog {padding-inline-start: 0 !important;}
     }
    .p-end.lwc-4r1413ceuog {padding-inline-end: 0 !important;}
        /* Header styling for mobile */
    .suggestions-combobox-container {top: 5px; position: relative; width: 150px;}
    }
   
    
      /*PDP- Styling: Top-Banner */
    .pdp-banner{ background-color: linear-gradient(106deg, #00556c, #468da9 100%, #8fc7e8 134%) !important; border-radius: 10px; }
    .Specifications{ font-weight:bold; color:#00556c; }
    .expandable-section-bg{ box-shadow: 0 8px 15px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); border-radius: 11px; background-color: #fff; }
        
    /* PDP Page Stylings */
    /* Video Component */
    .PDP-video {
     .cb-outputRichText-container.ql-editor img  {max-width: 100%; width: 170px; height: 186px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 22px;}
     }
    .pdp-lower-banner{ background-image: linear-gradient(106deg, #00556c, #468da9 100%, #8fc7e8 134%); border-radius: 10px; }
    
    .pdp-product-name{
     h1{font-size: 40px; line-height: 1.13; letter-spacing: -0.4px; margin-bottom: 20px;}
    }
    .pdp-lower-banner-heading{
      h2{font-size: 35px; font-weight: normal !important; font-stretch: normal; font-style: normal; line-height: 1.14; letter-spacing: -0.35px; text-align: left; }
     }
    .pdp-lower-banner-paragraph{
      h4{font-size: 18px; font-weight: normal !important; font-stretch: normal; font-style: normal; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: normal; text-align: left; color: #fff; margin: 20px 0 30px;}  
     }
    .specifications-content{
      h4{font-size: 16px; display: list-item !important; font-weight: normal !important;}
      ::marker {color: #00556C; height: 7px; widows: 7px;}
     }
    .expandable-section-bg{
     webruntimedesign-component-wrapper.component-wrapper-spacer.lwc-6jb05p8ont5-host {margin-bottom: 18px;}
    }

	/*Cart page*/
    .q-cart-form-wrap .slds-form-element__label {display: none;}
    .q-cart-form-wrap .slds-input {padding: 10px 15px}
    .q-cart-form-wrap .slds-card {border: 0;box-shadow: none;}
    .q-cart-form-wrap .slds-card__header-title {color: #53565a;}
    .q-shipping-info .slds-card__header {padding: 0; margin: 1.33em 0;}
    .q-cart-terms-cta .slds-button {border: 2px solid #00556c;color: #00556c;padding: 7px 30px;font-weight: 700;}
    .q-cart-terms-cta .slds-button:hover {color: #fff;background: #00556c;}
    .q-cart-terms-cta .slds-button:disabled {background-color: #eee;color: #fff;border-color: #eee;}
    .q-cart-terms-cta .slds-button:after {display:none;}
     .q-cart-detail-table .q-cart-terms-cta .slds-button {border: 2px solid #fb4f14;color: #fff;}
    .q-cart-detail-table .q-cart-terms-cta .slds-button:hover {border: 2px solid #d83a04;background: #d83a04;}
    .q-cart-detail-table .q-cart-terms-cta .slds-button:disabled {background-color: #eee;color: #fff;border-color: #eee;}
    .q-support-links .slds-button {border: 2px solid #fb4f14;color: #fff;padding: 6px 30px;background: #fb4f14;}
    .q-support-links .slds-button:hover {border: 2px solid #d83a04;background: #d83a04;}
    .header {position: unset !important;}
    .header .mini {position: fixed; top: 0;}
    .header .mini-tablet { position: fixed; top: 0;}
    .header .mini-mobile { position: fixed; top: 0;}
    
    /*Account page*/
	[data-component-id^="myAccountLayout"] .slds-grid {max-width:1200px; margin: auto}
    [data-component-id^="myAccountLayout"] .slds-nav-vertical .slds-nav-vertical__item {padding: 0;}
    [data-component-id^="myAccountLayout"] .slds-nav-vertical__action {color: #00556c !important;}
    [data-component-id^="myAccountLayout"] .slds-nav-vertical__action:hover {box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 #00556c; text-decoration: none;}
    [data-component-id^="myAccountLayout"] .slds-nav-vertical__item.slds-is-active .slds-nav-vertical__action {box-shadow: inset 4px 0 0 #00556c;}
    [data-component-id^="myAccountLayout"] .slds-tabs_default__nav .slds-tabs_default__item {font-size: 1rem; }
    [data-component-id^="myAccountLayout"] .slds-tabs_default__nav .slds-tabs_default__item a {color: #00556c;}
    [data-component-id^="myAccountLayout"] .address-card-style-class .address-footer-style:focus {box-shadow: none}
    @media (min-width: 768px) and (max-width: 1199px) {.suggestions-combobox-container {width: 220px;}}
        
    @media (max-width: 767px) {.mobile-center{text-align: center;}}
    /* PDP Responsive */
    @media (max-width: 479px){ 
     .PDP-video {
     .cb-outputRichText-container.ql-editor img {width: 155px;height: 171px;}
      }
     .pdp-video-one { width: 155px;height: 171px;}
     .pdp-video-two {position: relative !important; left: 12px !important;}
     .pdp-product-name{
      h1{font-size: 22px;}
      }
     .header-search-bar{position: relative;bottom: 35px;}
     }
    @media only screen and (max-width: 64em){
     .pdp-video-two {left: -50px; position: relative;}
    }
</style>
<script>
    document.addEventListener('scroll', function() {
        // Select the common elements
        const headerPromoBanner = document.querySelector('.header-wrapper .header-promo-banner');
        const headerDesktop = document.querySelector('.header-wrapper .desktop');
        const headerTablet = document.querySelector('.header-wrapper .tablet');
        const headerMobile = document.querySelector('.header-wrapper .mobile');

        // Ensure the promo banner exists
        if (!headerPromoBanner) return;

        // Define behavior based on viewport width
        if (window.innerWidth >= 1024) {
            // Desktop behavior
            if (headerDesktop) {
                if (window.pageYOffset > headerPromoBanner.offsetHeight) {
                    headerDesktop.classList.add('mini');
                } else {
                    headerDesktop.classList.remove('mini');
                }
            }
        } else if (window.innerWidth >= 768) {
            // Tablet behavior
            if (headerTablet) {
                if (window.pageYOffset > headerPromoBanner.offsetHeight) {
                    headerTablet.classList.add('mini-tablet');
                } else {
                    headerTablet.classList.remove('mini-tablet');
                }
            }
        } else {
            // Mobile behavior
            if (headerMobile) {
                if (window.pageYOffset > headerPromoBanner.offsetHeight) {
                    headerMobile.classList.add('mini-mobile');
                } else {
                    headerMobile.classList.remove('mini-mobile');
                }
            }
        }
    });
</script>
